authority_rule: Drive is canonical; this manifest exposes the layout-control contract to Git-based agents.
historical_seed: The historic single-line repair-house workflow remains a candidate functional principle. Historic road, pad, warehouse and placement dimensions do not define current layout.
relationship_families: residency/rest separation from industrial/launch/plant noise and hazards
public evidence views without restricted access
potable/emergency-wash separation from experimental reuse water
invariants: Emergency egress cannot depend on digital credentials.
Food/rest spaces do not form a contamination route.
Clean integration has controlled transfer and a separate dirty/waste return path.
Heavy-vehicle movement is segregated from pedestrian/public paths according to actual risk.
No launch/public/residency separation distance is guessed before QRA/licensing/site evidence.
Living systems cannot obstruct egress, security sightlines, cable access or maintenance.
